name: canonical_product_id
description: Primary Key. Master product, resort, or cruise voyage identifier (e.g. PRD-B629C).

name: google_place_id
description: Canonical Google Places API place_id used to deduplicate the 292,000 raw hotel strings in Databricks Silver.

name: raw_isell_string_variants
description: Number of unmapped free-text hotel string variations in Traveltek iSell resolved to this canonical entity.

name: canonical_name
description: Verified canonical resort or cruise ship + voyage name.

name: supplier_channel
description: Supplier channel: Vista_InHouse (15-25% margin), PO_Cruises, Jet2holidays, easyJet, or TUI.

name: product_category
description: Package category: Cruise_And_Stay, Ocean_Cruise, Short_Haul_Beach, or Long_Haul_MultiCentre.

name: gross_margin_pct
description: Gross margin or agency commission percentage (e.g. 21.8% for Vista vs 10.5% for 3rd-party suppliers).

name: min_margin_threshold_pct
description: Board '1/3 Mix' Mandate minimum target margin percentage for this product category.

name: verified_attributes
description: Pipe-delimited verified property/cabin attributes from Oak Intranet & Traveltek Cruise JSON API (e.g. Scooter_90cm_Door, Soft_Sand_Beach).
